stem: Alok's list has mean $18$. He inserts one new value, $24$, into the list.

statements.text: Because $24$ is greater than the current mean $18$, the mean increases.
The comparison uses the mean before the value is inserted.
The mean stays $18$ because the inserted value is only a new label, not a number in the list.

teacher.key_rationale: Inserting 24>18 pulls the mean up; the comparison is with the current mean before insertion. Statement 3 wrongly treats 24 as a mere label. Key is 1 and 2 only.
